summary: Nobody sent you: You offer to volunteer at {the party office}, and {committeeman} asks who sent you.
realLife: In 1948 he walked into his Chicago ward office to volunteer for Adlai Stevenson and Paul Douglas. Asked who sent him, he said nobody, and was turned away; he later called it the start of his political career.
gates: {the party office} is on record in your area.
weights: Your ties to anyone in the party.

choices: leave and find another way in: a reform club, an independent group
